UC-1170.en: You've used {n}% of your weekly {name} limit.
UC-1170.note: New: composer note above the field, before sending, from 90% of the weekly window (and less left than the 5-hour window); {name} is Claude or ChatGPT, {n} the share used as the plan card counts it, at most 99. Before, the weekly window never warned in the composer.

UC-1171.note: New: composer note's first sentence, before sending, from 75% of the 5-hour window; {name} Claude or ChatGPT, {n} the share used, at most 99. Replaces U12-24 "Close to your 5-hour limit." (shown only from 95%). 24 Nov ruling: warn before sending from 75% of the 5-hour window and 90% of the weekly one.

UC-1172.en: It resets at {time}. If it runs out mid-answer, the answer pauses until then.
UC-1172.note: New: composer note's second sentence, the reset today, in a <time>. Replaces U12-25 "Long tasks may pause until {time}." 24 Nov ruling: warn before sending from 75% of the 5-hour window and 90% of the weekly one.

UC-1173.en: It resets on {day} at {time}. If it runs out mid-answer, the answer pauses until then.
UC-1173.note: New: composer note's second sentence, the reset on another day, in a <time>. Replaces U12-26 "Long tasks may pause until {day} {time}." 24 Nov ruling: warn before sending from 75% of the 5-hour window and 90% of the weekly one.

UC-1174.en: If it runs out mid-answer, the answer pauses until it resets.
UC-1174.note: New: composer note's second sentence when the host gives no reset time. Before, the note had no second sentence then.

UC-1175.note: New: Settings side list, beside Plan and usage: each plan named, joined with " · " ("Claude: 17% left · ChatGPT: 60% left"); {n} the share left of its 5-hour limit. Replaces U12-38 "{n}% of the 5-hour limit left", which named no plan: a Windows tester with ChatGPT chosen read Claude's figure as ChatGPT's.

UC-1176.note: New: Settings side list, an agent billed by use, named, joined with " · " as UC-1175. Replaces U12-39 "Pay as you go".
